rules: New bank: exactly two uniformly random edges out of 16; empirical query MSE below 0.1 filters elites. No teacher support enters bank selection.
The sine task and source SGD follow the historical experiment. Bank sampling seeds are new; this is not an exact reproduction of its 279 elites.
Current IndexMADE learns 16 binary activity tokens. Every active edge has a separate fresh coefficient, making masks a special case of indexators.
Prior checkpoint minimizes NLL on source cards held out before filtering. No target masks or task identities enter its training.
Raw AR is primary. AR budget2 conditions sequential generation only on the already known total of two edges; it is a declared diagnostic variant.
Independent frequencies are Bernoulli probabilities estimated from training masks, without output-role constraints. Uniform samples exactly two of 16 edges.
Temperature is chosen by query-selected solver quality on structurally held-out calibration pairs; all three prior seeds are retained.
Dense SGD and Adam learning rates and initialization scales are calibrated on the same calibration functions. Structural SGD settings stay historical and fixed.

Each target search spends 64 fits of 1024 steps and batch 64. Structural proposals receive 32 exploratory fits using four initial vectors, then 32 fresh fits of the query-selected mask. Dense and oracle receive 64 independent starts.
Within a search, target models share minibatch and query streams. The final candidate minimizes empirical query MSE across both stages. Analytic Gaussian population MSE is report-only.
Only final fit states are selected; intermediate histories are diagnostic. All trials, masks, selected weights, histories and source elites are retained.
Novel and familiar structure conditions are separate. All eight/16 numerical tasks are new. Three generators share one source bank and the same target tasks.
No global minimum claim, no target-based retuning, no tests. Report negative results and full source/calibration cost.
